WITH category_map AS ( SELECT 'MAIL' AS category, '메일 문의' AS category_name, 1 AS sort_order FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'MAP', '지도 문의', 2 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'STOCK', '증권 문의', 3 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'NEWS', '뉴스 문의', 4 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'WEATHER', '날씨 문의', 5 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'CALENDAR', '캘린더 문의', 6 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'ETC', '기타 문의', 7 FROM dual ) SELECT cm.category, cm.category_name, COUNT(r.room_no) AS chat_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count FROM category_map cm LEFT JOIN chat_room r ON cm.category = r.category GROUP BY cm.category, cm.category_name, cm.sort_order ORDER BY cm.sort_order

WITH days AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7 + LEVEL AS stat_day FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.stat_day, 'MM/DD') AS date_label, COUNT(r.room_no) AS chat_count FROM days d LEFT JOIN chat_room r ON TRUNC(r.created_date) = d.stat_day GROUP BY d.stat_day ORDER BY d.stat_day

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.room_no, r.user_no, r.admin_no, user_member.nickname AS user_nickname, admin_member.nickname AS admin_nickname, r.status, r.category, CASE r.category WHEN 'MAIL' THEN '메일 문의' WHEN 'MAP' THEN '지도 문의' WHEN 'STOCK' THEN '증권 문의' WHEN 'NEWS' THEN '뉴스 문의' WHEN 'WEATHER' THEN '날씨 문의' WHEN 'CALENDAR' THEN '캘린더 문의' WHEN 'ETC' THEN '기타 문의' ELSE '일반 문의' END AS category_name, r.last_message, r.last_message_date, r.created_date, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_no = r.room_no AND m.sender_no = r.user_no AND m.read_yn = 'N' ) AS unread_count FROM chat_room r LEFT JOIN member user_member ON r.user_no = user_member.no LEFT JOIN member admin_member ON r.admin_no = admin_member.no ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, r.last_message_date DESC NULLS LAST, r.created_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
